fields.acceptance: feed.txtar: by default an actor-only record is hidden while a planning record and an intention are shown, and with --all all three are shown; with --limit the pages are full and the next-page line carries --all; the changes app test hides the actor-only change set; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: rhiza feed and the changes app leave out landed change sets whose ops only create or update actor nodes unless --all is given, filtering before paging so pages stay full and cursors stable
